skill.summary: EVE manages the full research lifecycle with Auto, Semi-Manual, or Manual modes to produce a publication-ready LaTeX paper from topic search to gap analysis.

latestVersion.changelog:
eve-research-supervisor-pro v5.1.0

- Onboarding streamlined: now asks all profile questions in one message instead of one-by-one, simplifying first-time setup.
- Project creation: both topic and save directory are collected in a single message for improved efficiency.
- Directory management clarified: default directory path used if none is specified by user.
- Session flow refined: onboarding, project setup, and mode selection are each more concise and direct.
- User prompts updated for clarity, guiding users through each step with single, multi-question prompts.
